evidence.frontage_band: a lot frontage of 7.6 metres or less

calculation_handling.description: A parking space inside a building (not an ancillary building) in the R zone may be converted to habitable space with no replacement parking if the lot frontage is 7.6 m or less, or if it is greater than 7.6 m and the vehicle-entrance floor is below established grade.
calculation_handling.gaps: Only arm (i) (frontage ≤ 7.6 m) is expressed in condition.if; arm (ii) (frontage > 7.6 m with the vehicle-entrance floor below established grade) needs the entrance elevation, which has no DSL input, so the condition is conservatively the frontage arm only. The second 7.6 m occurrence in (ii) is the same threshold. Requires an existing in-building parking space; ancillary buildings are excluded (building_types 'any' as no permitted type is named in this arm).

units.disclosure: Converting an indoor parking space (e.g. a garage) to living space without replacing the parking is allowed on lots 7.6 m wide or less, or on wider lots where the garage floor is below grade. We check the frontage only; we cannot check the garage floor level.

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the conversion permission in (1): the parking space must be in a detached house, semi-detached house or townhouse.
calculation_handling.gaps: Requires an existing in-building parking space, which we do not hold.

units.disclosure: The garage-to-living-space conversion applies only to detached houses, semi-detached houses and townhouses. We do not hold information about existing garages.

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the conversion permission in (1): the vehicle entrance to the parking space must be in the front main wall.
calculation_handling.gaps: 'in the front main wall' is mapped to garage_entrance_faces_street as the closest token; the front main wall is not strictly the same as facing a street (e.g. corner lots). Requires an existing in-building parking space.

units.disclosure: The conversion applies only where the garage door is in the front wall of the house. We do not hold information about existing garage entrances.

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the conversion permission in (1): the driveway to the vehicle entrance must be removed and any front-yard depression filled to established grade.
calculation_handling.gaps: A non-numeric precondition with no requirement token; keyed as part of the PERMIT. Requires an existing driveway and garage.

units.disclosure: To convert the garage, the driveway leading to it must be removed and any dip in the front yard filled to grade. We do not hold existing driveway information.

calculation_handling.description: A parking space inside a building in the R zone may be converted to interior floor area for a use under 10.10.20.100(21) or (22), with no replacement parking, if the space is in a residential building other than an apartment building.
calculation_handling.gaps: The text names residential buildings other than an apartment building (an exclusion, not a list), so building_types is 'any' with apartment_building excluded by the text; ancillary buildings are also excluded. The non-residential use under 10.10.20.100(21)/(22) has no vocab.uses token.

units.disclosure: An indoor parking space in a house (not an apartment building) can be converted to space for certain permitted non-residential uses without replacing the parking. We do not hold information about existing garages.

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the conversion permission in (2): the vehicle entrance to the parking space must be in the building's front main wall.
calculation_handling.gaps: 'in the front main wall' mapped to garage_entrance_faces_street as the closest token. Requires an existing in-building parking space.

units.disclosure: This conversion applies only where the garage door is in the front wall. We do not hold existing garage information.

calculation_handling.description: Condition of the conversion permission in (2): the driveway to the vehicle entrance must be removed and any front-yard depression filled to established grade.
calculation_handling.gaps: A non-numeric precondition with no requirement token; keyed as part of the PERMIT.

units.disclosure: The driveway to the converted garage must be removed and the front yard filled to grade. We do not hold existing driveway information.

calculation_handling.description: The removed driveway area in the front yard must be landscaping, but may still be counted as a permitted driveway when calculating required soft landscaping under 10.5.50.10(1)(D).
calculation_handling.gaps: Also contains a deeming rule for the soft-landscaping calculation, recorded here in the description. Requires an existing driveway being removed.

units.disclosure: The area of the removed driveway must become landscaping. We do not hold existing driveway information.

calculation_handling.description: A parking space in the front yard or a side yard abutting a street is subject to 10.5.80.10(3) or must be authorized by a minor variance.
calculation_handling.gaps: 'Section 45' is a statutory section number, not a literal. Applies to an existing or proposed front/side-yard parking space, which we do not hold.

units.disclosure: Any parking in the front yard or street-side yard must meet the front-yard parking rule or get a minor variance. We do not hold existing parking pad information.

calculation_handling.description: Regulation 200.5.10.11(1)(C) does not apply to the parking space being converted under (2).
calculation_handling.gaps: Displaces 200.5.10.11(1)(C) for the converted parking space only (no displaces field in the template).

units.disclosure: A parking rule (200.5.10.11(1)(C)) is waived for the parking space being converted. We do not hold existing garage information.

10.10.80.1(1).explanation: In the R zone, an indoor parking space (such as an attached garage) in a detached house, semi-detached house or townhouse can be converted to living space without providing replacement parking, if the lot is 7.6 m wide or less (or wider with a below-grade garage floor), the garage door is in the front wall, and the driveway is removed with the front yard filled to grade.

10.10.80.1(2).explanation: In the R zone, an indoor parking space in a house (not an apartment building) can be converted to floor area for certain permitted non-residential uses without replacement parking, if the garage door is in the front wall and the driveway is removed and landscaped. Any front or street-side yard parking must meet the parking rules or get a minor variance.
